text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the holidays.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And today, Maruzensky is holding a
party for the
younger students.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen! Thank you so much for
preparing such a
wonderful party!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heehee! Are you enjoying yourself?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Not only is it fun, but the food is
great
too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You just keep eating nonstop, Spe!
Aren't you
worried about training
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! From the moment the party
started, I'd
already resigned myself to
my fate!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I don't see how that makes it okay, but
sure...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, c'mon, it'd be a waste not to enjoy
ourselves
at a party!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The best thing to do is have fun and eat
all the
goodies we can! Forget about the
rest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You're right! It would be rude to
restrain
oneself.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So get eating, King! We can cry on the
scale
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky, are you sure your idea of a party
isn't poking
fun at me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, what a wonderful day we're
having. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today,
Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! ♪ I'm so happy
everyone is
having fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days earlier...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me carry everything,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me carry everything,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now we're all set to raise the roof with
the
younger students.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! I can't wait to see everyone's
happy
faces!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's because they're all so cute!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I just want to watch over them, you
know? I want
to see them happy and
healthy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know the saying? "Even
naughty kids
deserve to grow up strong!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh? My mom says it all the time...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I want to reward all of them for
working
so hard this year!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So I hope you'll help me see it through!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's going to be off the hook!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so happy to have fun with
everyone
like this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You and your trainer are like our Santa
Clauses!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Teehee, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give presents to all you
good little
ponies! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now come on, let's party to the max!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm gonna stuff myself silly!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I had the best time! ♪ Thanks for all
your help,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I had the best time! ♪ Thanks for all
your help,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've given out presents, so now
it's time
for Santa to return to the North
Pole! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As long as everyone is happy, that's all
that
matters to me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, do I look like the type to be
excited
about getting presents?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You really want to give me a
present,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You really want to give me a
present,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! So I guess that makes you my
Santa
Claus, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! So I guess that makes you my
Santa
Claus, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It'd be rude not to accept, so I guess I'll
let you
spoil me a little!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, what gift would I like... How about
going for
a drive with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, our exciting party continues.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky, you've been good too,
y'know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I want to give you a gift
too! What
would you like?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's fine, really! I'm the oldest here, so...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, if even you say so...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, if even you say so...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, I've got it! What if I'm your present?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My gift is to keep being your running

competition!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And I'll continue running with you as
well, just like
Spe! ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No fair! I can't let you guys have all the
fun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'll be your racing partner too, Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'll accept the challenge as
well!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...So that's where this is going, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess all of us together might
actually
make for one heck of a race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting with Special Week, all of the
younger
students then volunteer to be
running partners
with Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I guess everyone is my Santa Claus, today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I accept all of your wonderful
gifts!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So come and get me, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the holiday party ends with smiles
all
around.
